title: Wasm Curves Public
objective: Make public elliptic L-series and plot workflows select existing exact portable coefficient and root-number fallbacks when eclib exports are absent

oracles: eclib root numbers for representative semistable curves
existing native ecApIntegral and ecAnlistIntegral results

handoff.summary: Public elliptic ap/anlist now capability-check optional smalljac exports and retain the exact direct point-count/Euler recurrence; semistable global root numbers use certified Tate local data, with an explicit checked precomputed override for additive curves when eclib is absent.
risks: The portable direct point counter is exact but intentionally slower than smalljac at large coefficient bounds.
Portable additive local root-number formulas remain unimplemented; callers must provide a certified precomputed sign rather than receiving a guess.
next_steps: Run the E37 public L-series and complex_plot fixtures in the integrated Chromium Wasm build.
Consider a future portable fast elliptic point-counting backend if large-conductor browser coefficient generation becomes a measured bottleneck.
